text: +3 to this weapon’s attack and damage rolls. Reference-only: on an Attack action, transform it into any Simple Melee weapon, Battleaxe, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Warhammer until your next turn starts. Choose Strength or Dexterity for both attack and damage in any form. Once per dawn, reroll a missed attack and keep the new roll.
